paper_title: Projection-free Adaptive Regret with Membership Oracles
authors: Zhou Lu, Nataly Brukhim, Paula Gradu, Elad Hazan
statement: 7. Conclusion In this paper, we consider the problem of online convex optimization √ with membership oracles. We propose a simple lazy OGD algorithm that achieves O( T ) and O(log T ) regret bounds for general convex and strongly-convex loss functions respectively, using O(d log T ) number of calls to the membership oracle. We further utilize the active nature of our algorithm in adaptive regret minimization, achieving better bounds than known algorithms using linear optimization oracles. It remains open to try to match these regret bounds using linear optimization, or alternatively fewer membership oracle queries.
